metrics.profile_summary: Entrepreneurial marketing professional with over 3 years of experience in digital strategy and social media management. Expert in driving brand growth and managing cross-functional teams within e-commerce and agency environments.

experience.description: Developed digital marketing strategies, managed social media presence across Meta and Instagram, executed targeted ad campaigns, and led cross-functional teams of designers and copywriters.
Launched a social media marketing agency specializing in UK car dealerships, implementing strategies to increase brand visibility and customer engagement.

strengths: Strong proficiency in Meta Ads and social media management tools
Proven track record of increasing social media following and traffic
Experience managing designers and external assets
weaknesses: No explicit mention of TikTok or Canva
evaluation.summary: The candidate exceeds the minimum experience and education requirements. Their background as a Head of Marketing and Agency Co-founder provides the exact technical skill set needed for social media scheduling, campaign reporting, and asset coordination.
